title: [OpenConnect] Explain "Store browser cookies in plain-text" and use a better wording
line: The OpenConnect sign-in dialog now says "Remember web sign-in" and has a help button explaining what it keeps and that it is stored unencrypted.
explanation: The OpenConnect authentication dialog has a checkbox "Store browser cookies in plain-text" that makes the embedded single sign-on web page keep its cookies on disk between connections. The label didn't say which browser was meant or why anyone would want it, and nothing explained it. The change renames it to "Remember web sign-in" and adds a KContextualHelpButton next to it explaining that some VPN servers use a web sign-in page, that keeping its cookies can avoid signing in again, and that they are saved unencrypted in the home folder.

commits.message:
vpn/openconnect: explain the option to keep web sign-in cookies

"Store browser cookies in plain-text" didn't say which browser was meant
or why you would want it. Call it "Remember web sign-in" and add a help
button that explains what is kept, why, and that it is not encrypted.

BUG: 504207

patches.diff:
From 95fb025640a95604eb2485414035bf07c18098e3 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 17:46:31 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] vpn/openconnect: explain the option to keep web sign-in
 cookies

"Store browser cookies in plain-text" didn't say which browser was meant
or why you would want it. Call it "Remember web sign-in" and add a help
button that explains what is kept, why, and that it is not encrypted.

BUG: 504207
---
 vpn/openconnect/openconnectauth.cpp |  1 +
 vpn/openconnect/openconnectauth.ui  | 41 +++++++++++++++++++++++++----
 2 files changed, 37 insertions(+), 5 deletions(-)

diff --git a/vpn/openconnect/openconnectauth.cpp b/vpn/openconnect/openconnectauth.cpp
index a02b55b67..91b4adaa7 100644
--- a/vpn/openconnect/openconnectauth.cpp
+++ b/vpn/openconnect/openconnectauth.cpp
@@ -125,6 +125,7 @@ OpenconnectAuthWidget::OpenconnectAuthWidget(const NetworkManager::VpnSetting::P
     d->ui.cmbLogLevel->setCurrentIndex(OpenconnectAuthWidgetPrivate::Debug);
     d->ui.btnConnect->setIcon(QIcon::fromTheme("network-connect"));
     d->ui.viewServerLog->setChecked(false);
+    d->ui.cookiesHelpButton->setHeightHintWidget(d->ui.chkStorePlaintextCookies);
 
     d->worker = new OpenconnectAuthWorkerThread(&d->mutex, &d->workerWaiting, &d->userQuit, &d->formGroupChanged, d->cancelPipes[0]);
 
diff --git a/vpn/openconnect/openconnectauth.ui b/vpn/openconnect/openconnectauth.ui
index 4bd60191b..04af03987 100644
--- a/vpn/openconnect/openconnectauth.ui
+++ b/vpn/openconnect/openconnectauth.ui
@@ -111,11 +111,35 @@
     </widget>
    </item>
    <item>
-    <widget class="QCheckBox" name="chkStorePlaintextCookies">
-     <property name="text">
-      <string>Store browser cookies in plain-text</string>
-     </property>
-    </widget>
+    <layout class="QHBoxLayout" name="cookiesLayout">
+     <item>
+      <widget class="QCheckBox" name="chkStorePlaintextCookies">
+       <property name="text">
+        <string>Remember web sign-in</string>
+       </property>
+      </widget>
+     </item>
+     <item>
+      <widget class="KContextualHelpButton" name="cookiesHelpButton">
+       <property name="contextualHelpText">
+        <string>Some VPN servers ask you to sign in on a web page. When this is checked, the cookies from that page are kept so you might not need to sign in again next time. They are saved unencrypted in your home folder.</string>
+       </property>
+      </widget>
+     </item>
+     <item>
+      <spacer name="cookiesSpacer">
+       <property name="orientation">
+        <enum>Qt::Orientation::Horizontal</enum>
+       </property>
+       <property name="sizeHint" stdset="0">
+        <size>
+         <width>0</width>
+         <height>0</height>
+        </size>
+       </property>
+      </spacer>
+     </item>
+    </layout>
    </item>
    <item>
     <widget class="QGroupBox" name="loginBox">
@@ -240,6 +264,13 @@
    </item>
   </layout>
  </widget>
+ <customwidgets>
+  <customwidget>
+   <class>KContextualHelpButton</class>
+   <extends>QToolButton</extends>
+   <header>kcontextualhelpbutton.h</header>
+  </customwidget>
+ </customwidgets>
  <resources/>
  <connections/>
 </ui>
--
